story.blind_name: Members split near-evenly: pushes CE down for clean word/name completions (cooperate, Koch, shall); pushes CE up for garbled/sub-word fragments (mojibake, angers, ication).

certification.test: concentration replicated on both corpus halves (identity rule v2)
certification.source: SOP-v2 identity-rule check, manual half-split of leaf_ablate dCE

certification.bar: within ~0.1 of pack value (pack is a 60-row subsample)

certification.test: story red-team on 3 random examples (causal-direction reading)

certification.objection: Gate reproduces exactly (concentration 6.67, 0% deviation). Initial fresh draw (seed=11, nrand=5) scored 4/5 on the story sign prediction but was skewed 4-clean/1-fragment, so the specific fragment-hurts claim was barely exercised. A class-targeted redraw of 5 members whose target token has no leading space (sub-word fragments: 'J', 'ound', 'PA', accented 'a', 'al') scored only 2/5 -- below the >=4/5 bar required because program_bacc (0.609) already failed its own 0.75 bar. Combined 6/10 (60%). Strongest objection: the story's dichotomy (clean word/name vs garbled/sub-word fragment) is not an independent semantic finding -- it is definitionally the same bit as the tokenizer's starts_space feature (the record's own program is class_subword AND NOT is_newline, and class_subword in circuit_dictionary.classify is literally 'not tg.startswith(space) and s.isalpha()'). Scoring the trivial rule 'starts_space predicts help' against the same 10 examples gives the identical 6/10, since the story's help/hurt calls were assigned by that same boundary. So even granting the story its own framing, the underlying trivial tokenizer rule only holds 60% of the time on fresh draws and drops to 40% on the class it specifically names (fragments) -- this reads as a narrative wrapped around a near-coin-flip tokenizer heuristic, not a validated mechanism (the record's own mechanism_level is already 'none').

localisation.method: direct causal ablation, two counterfactuals, 36 components over census_state_diverse (256,000 positions). concentration = mean|dCE| on members / mean|dCE| off slice.
localisation.caveat: the two counterfactuals name different components; S2054 had already flagged this circuit as effectively tied, so treat the site as undetermined
